root_cause: The bilingual SEO implementation added and recomposed visible Dutch strings at two stages: source HTML and late SEO/order enrichment. Production requires a complete committed English cache for the final built estate, so source-only cache validation found the first 23 gaps while exact Netlify build parity exposed 9 additional late-generated strings.
prevention: Every visible source-string change on localized public routes must update the committed English translation cache in the same candidate.
Validate source cache completeness before merge and run the exact Netlify production build parity because late SEO/order enrichment can create additional exact strings after source validation.
Cache the exact final string emitted by the production build, including generated headings, comparison copy, support handoffs and CTA labels.
Never bypass STATIC_I18N_REQUIRE_CACHE or allow Dutch fallback on English production pages.
fix: Add all 32 observed missing exact strings to the canonical English cache patch: 23 source strings plus 9 late SEO/order-enrichment strings, while preserving the fail-closed production and build-parity gates.
